sentences.text: Marta llevaba cinco años trabajando en la misma empresa.
sentences.translation: Marta had been working at the same company for five years.

sentences.text: Aunque el sueldo era bueno, ya no se sentía motivada.
sentences.translation: Although the salary was good, she no longer felt motivated.

sentences.text: Un día recibió una oferta de trabajo en otra ciudad.
sentences.translation: One day she received a job offer in another city.

sentences.text: El puesto era más interesante, pero implicaba mudarse lejos de su familia.
sentences.translation: The position was more interesting, but it meant moving far from her family.

sentences.text: Pasó varias noches sin dormir, pensando en lo que debía hacer.
sentences.translation: She spent several sleepless nights thinking about what she should do.

sentences.text: Habló con sus padres, quienes le dijeron que la apoyarían pasara lo que pasara.
sentences.translation: She talked with her parents, who told her they would support her no matter what.

sentences.text: Finalmente, decidió aceptar el reto y empezar una nueva etapa.
sentences.translation: Finally, she decided to accept the challenge and begin a new chapter.

sentences.text: Aunque tenía miedo, sabía que era la decisión correcta.
sentences.translation: Although she was afraid, she knew it was the right decision.

sentences.text: Meses después, se alegró de haber sido valiente.
sentences.translation: Months later, she was glad she had been brave.

questions.question: Why was Marta unhappy at her job?
What did the new job require?

sentences.text: El profesor propuso un debate sobre el uso de la tecnología en las escuelas.
sentences.translation: The teacher proposed a debate on the use of technology in schools.

sentences.text: La clase se dividió en dos grupos con opiniones opuestas.
sentences.translation: The class split into two groups with opposing opinions.

sentences.text: El primer grupo defendía que las pantallas mejoran el aprendizaje.
sentences.translation: The first group argued that screens improve learning.

sentences.text: El segundo grupo sostenía que distraen a los estudiantes.
sentences.translation: The second group maintained that they distract students.

sentences.text: Cada equipo presentó argumentos con ejemplos concretos.
sentences.translation: Each team presented arguments with concrete examples.

sentences.text: A pesar de las diferencias, todos se escucharon con respeto.
sentences.translation: Despite the differences, everyone listened to each other with respect.

sentences.text: Al final, el profesor destacó que no había una única respuesta correcta.
sentences.translation: In the end, the teacher emphasized that there was no single correct answer.

sentences.text: Los alumnos comprendieron que el equilibrio era lo más importante.
sentences.translation: The students understood that balance was the most important thing.

questions.question: What did the second group claim?
What did the teacher conclude?
options: There was no single correct answer
